methodology.process: One fresh process per form, size, axis and round; sequential execution.
methodology.order: Size order reverses/rotates by round; form order alternates; phase order alternates per pass.
methodology.preparation: Real worker parse, first resolution and one capture pass precede explicit warmups.
methodology.capture: emitDartScopeCaptures over all files; includes tree-sitter parsing.
methodology.resolve: runScopeResolution; structured clone and graph replay excluded from timing.
methodology.correctness: Exact workload formulas and full graph fingerprint on every resolution; paired form equality.
methodology.exclusions: No filesystem scanning, persistence, config loading, end-to-end analyze or full-pipeline memory claim.
methodology.inference: Log-log slopes are finite-range descriptions, not asymptotic proofs. Round ranges are not confidence intervals.
